catalog.title: The Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Clothes with character
catalog.text: GADYUKA makes stylish, comfortable clothing built on original, in-house design. Our philosophy is comfort and beauty in one — never a cliché. We create clothes that bring out what makes each person unique, cut for the rhythm of the big city.

about.label: About
about.title: Why GADYUKA
about.imageCaption: He never turns around. They know him anyway.
about.text: Our brand offers stylish, comfortable clothing with original, in-house design. We pay close attention to quality and detail so you feel confident and look sharp. Choosing GADYUKA means choosing quality and individuality.

0.title: Original designs
0.text: Every piece is designed in-house — no clichés.

1.title: Quality and detail
1.text: Close attention to fabric, fit and every small detail.

2.title: Individuality
2.text: Clothes that bring out your character and keep pace with the big city.

about.closeupCaption: Close-up. Choose GADYUKA — choose quality and individuality.

tailoring.title: Made to Measure
tailoring.imageCaption: Patterns — the foundation of every piece
tailoring.subtitle: Sewn to your measurements
tailoring.text: Order a piece made just for you. We create one-of-a-kind garments that fit you perfectly. Tell us what you have in mind — and we'll bring it to life.

0.title: Cut to your measurements
0.text: Clothing tailored to your individual measurements and wishes — a chance to create a unique look that matches your style.

1.title: Why made to measure
1.text: A perfect fit, your choice of fabric and design, and a look no one else has.

2.title: How to order
2.text: Describe what you have in mind, then choose a model and fabric. Our team will help you create a look that is entirely yours.

offers.title: Special Offers

gallery.title: Gallery

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.text: GADYUKA's original designs pair a sharp look with the comfort that big-city life demands.
reviews.empty: The witnesses are keeping quiet — for now. Wearing GADYUKA? Tell us — write to the editor.

partners.title: GADYUKA Partners
partners.text: We collaborate with other brands and organisations to bring you the best products and services. Learn more about our partnerships and how we work together to create stylish, comfortable clothing.
